checks.name: static_review
checks.details: Exactly TopModule with two 100-bit ports; each output bit has one continuous driver from input bit 99-i. No state, latch, clock, reset, arithmetic, or external module dependency. Net ports use wire for continuous wiring.

checks.name: initial_preservation
checks.result: Identical; initial preserved before development checks

development_outcome: Initial candidate passed directed, walking-one, walking-zero, 1000 random-vector, and mixed X/Z checks. No RTL revisions needed.
limitations: Development simulation is independent and does not establish official evaluation results.
